items.note: The prompt states the decision: keep using Postgres with pgvector or adopt a dedicated vector database.
The prompt states about 5 million embeddings at 1536 dimensions, growing about 1 million per quarter.
The prompt says they already run Postgres 16 on AWS RDS.
The prompt states a budget under $500 per month, though it adds the word 'all-in'.
The prompt says every query must filter by tenant_id because the system is multi-tenant.
The prompt caps the comparison at 4 options in total, with pgvector included.
The output order puts a comparison table first and one clear recommendation third.
The prompt limits sources to the last 12 months (since October 2025) and labels any older sources separately.
The steps run a wide scan first, then a deep dive on the top 2.

invented: The budget is described as 'all-in'. The person only said under $500 per month and never said what the figure covers.
